lossDisclosure: Earlier uncommitted managed worktree disappeared during execution. Raw captures in that directory are unavailable and are not accepted as retained evidence. Recovered command construction from this chat was re-executed in this checkout; current receipts will identify the new execution.

artifactOwnership.scope: Every file in raw/ is owned by this task and produced by capture-governance-rerun.mjs; streams, input snapshots and execution journals are execution artifacts, not prose candidates.
artifactOwnership.timeAndVersion: Per execution/session startedAt/finishedAt, sourceHead and captured input hashes; applies only to those inputs.
artifactOwnership.retention: Git-tracked raw bytes are immutable; re-execution creates a new UUID, never overwrites.
artifactOwnership.exitCondition: No automatic deletion during rework; any retirement requires an explicit reviewed replacement and provenance mapping.
